name: luna-shopper-backend-auth
comment: Runtime dependency manifest for the container image. Development uses the single root package.json (plan 0003); this is the authoritative list of what the built service needs at runtime, so `nx prune` produces a pruned package.json + lockfile for a reproducible `npm ci` in the Dockerfile (plan 0002, section 3). Includes the deps the bundled @portfolio/luna-shopper/platform code pulls in (pino/terminus/swagger/throttler/class-validator, and the OpenTelemetry SDK that `main.ts` loads before anything else). ioredis is in that set even though this service never touches Redis: the platform barrel re-exports RedisService, so every bundle that imports anything from it emits a top level `require("ioredis")` and the container dies at boot without it. Keep in sync with the imports the service actually uses, and check the built main.js rather than the source when a dependency looks unused.
